description: Update an open order by `orderId` with partial fields (`receiver`, `newPrice`). Returns `{ success, message, code }`. Side effect: overwrites live order parameters; not idempotent — each call with a different `newPrice` produces a new state. Requires a wallet signature identity (the order's owner). Prefer this over cancel+recreate when only price/receiver should change. Verify state with `tronsave_get_order` first; fails for already-fulfilled, already-cancelled, or non-editable orders.

newPrice.description: Optional replacement unit price in SUN per resource unit.

orderId.description: Target order id (`MObjectId`) to update. Order must still be open and editable.

name: tronsave_update_order

anyOf.description: GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing.

code.description: GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing.

anyOf.description: Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure.
